cases.name: a start: one met, one on its way
cases.lean:
import AvenDB.Objective
open AvenDB.Objective

namespace Objectives.Start

/-- V1 shows its first frame within 1.5 s on the 8 GB Mac. -/
def firstFrame : Metric := metric "First frame, ms" (atMost (reading "first_frame_ms") 1500)

/-- At least 50 frames a second while walking. -/
def fps : Metric := metric "Frames per second" (atLeast (reading "fps") 50)

def objective : List Metric := [firstFrame, fps]

end Objectives.Start

cases.name: memory: names, decimals, between, equals, minus, product and quotient
cases.lean:
import AvenDB.Objective
open AvenDB.Objective

namespace Objectives.Memory

/- What the world streaming must keep: the heap well under its budget,
   /- a nested comment -/ and the frame time steady. -/

-- the heap's share of its budget
def heapShare : Expr := reading "heap_mb" / reading "budget_mb"

/-- The heap takes at most 80 % of its budget. -/
def memory : Metric := metric "Heap share of budget" (atMost heapShare 0.8)

/-- Frame time between 8.3 and 16.7 ms, the worse of two scenes. -/
def frame : Metric :=
  metric "Frame time, ms" (between (max (reading "frame_a_ms") (reading "frame_b_ms")) 8.3 16.7)

/-- Exactly three settlers, after one leaves: arithmetic and a minus. -/
def settlers : Metric := metric "Settlers" (equals (reading "settlers" - 1) 3)

/-- A drift that should stay small either way. -/
def drift : Metric := metric "Drift" (atMost (max (reading "drift") (-(reading "drift"))) 0.25)

/-- Saved share of the old cost, by product and sum. -/
def saving : Metric :=
  metric "Saving" (atLeast ((reading "old" - reading "new") * 100 / reading "old") 30.5)

def objective : List Metric := [memory, frame, settlers, drift, saving]

end Objectives.Memory

cases.name: unmeasured: missing, by zero, beyond the bound, worse, flat, fine digits
lines: the proposal's numbers against main's, a new field, and a reading beside
cases.lean:
import AvenDB.Objective
open AvenDB.Objective

namespace Objectives.Lines

/-- The valley's corn grows at least 0.8 m tall, as the proposal sets it. -/
def height : Metric := metric "Corn height, m" (atLeast (proposed "params.#1.default") 0.8)

/-- The rules move up exactly one engine version. -/
def step : Expr := proposed "engine.version" - current "engine.version"
def engine : Metric := metric "Engine versions up" (equals step 1)

/-- A new field main doesn't hold yet: no baseline, so met or nothing. -/
def water : Metric := metric "Water a week, l" (between (proposed "params.#2.default") 10 20)

/-- Ripe within 120 days, as measured. -/
def ripe : Metric := metric "Day the corn is ripe" (atMost (reading "ripe_day") 120)

def objective : List Metric := [height, engine, water, ripe]

end Objectives.Lines

cases.name: measured: the author's reading counts as a reading, never as measured
cases.lean:
import AvenDB.Objective
open AvenDB.Objective

namespace Objectives.Measured

/-- The valley sim, run on the proposal by a Measurer of the vault, never the author: at least 50 frames a second. -/
def fps : Metric := metric "Frames per second, measured" (atLeast (measured "fps") 50)

/-- Every reading counts here, the author's too. -/
def claimed : Metric := metric "Frames per second, any reading" (atLeast (reading "fps") 50)

def objective : List Metric := [fps, claimed]

end Objectives.Measured
